item.title: Oxford Paper Finds Frontier LLM Agents Fail to Coordinate Over Arbitrary Conventions
item.description:
A new Oxford paper finds that frontier LLM agents from different vendors struggle to coordinate without agreed rules, because each treats its own arbitrary convention as the obvious choice. Testing text and code agents built on models such as GPT-5.2 and Gemini 3 Pro across nine small cooperative games, paired agents scored well below the safe baseline; a short shared statement of coordination principles reliably steered them to the safe option.

原文标题：牛津新论文：前沿 LLM 智能体因各自默认规则难以协作

Why it matters：该研究直指多智能体互操作的核心失效机制，并给出可立即采用的提示词级缓解方案，对构建跨厂商智能体系统的开发者有直接参考价值。

item.title: Study Finds AI Auditors Catch Most Agent Misbehavior but Flood Reviewers With False Alarms
item.description:
Andy Hall, a researcher at the Anthropic Institute, replicated and extended METR's MALT dataset study and found that frontier models can flag most problematic agent behavior in logs, but pushing for higher recall produces a flood of false positives that mark harmless actions as suspicious. The conclusion: AI auditors are better suited to estimating incident rates than to serving as zero-miss safety gates, and those granting agents approval-free permissions should bear more responsibility.

原文标题：研究：AI 审计能抓多数智能体越界行为，但误报泛滥

Why it matters：首次系统量化 AI 审计 AI 的召回与误报权衡，直接影响智能体安全部署与审批权限设计。

item.title: Developer Flags GPUI Pitfalls, Switches Back to Electron for Agent-Friendly Workflow
item.description:
Developer Baoyu reviewed his experience building the baocut desktop app on GPUI, noting that beyond performance and cross-platform strengths, the Rust-native UI framework requires forking for complex UIs, has weak accessibility support, heavy compile resource and time costs, no hot reload, and costly agent-driven UI verification. He ultimately returned to Electron while keeping complex rendering and transcription/TTS modules as Rust/WASM and worker processes to balance iteration speed with backend performance.

原文标题：开发者复盘 GPUI 踩坑：编译慢、无热更新，转回 Electron

Why it matters：来自一线开发者的真实工程复盘，为评估 Rust 原生 UI 框架与 Electron 在 Agent 协作开发场景下的取舍提供了具体经验。

item.title: Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Small Model Swears Repeatedly During Benchmark Runs
item.description:
Researchers at Vals AI examined the chain-of-thought logs of Thinking Machines' open-weight Inkling 2 Small across 2,655 runs on 13 benchmarks, finding profanity in 50 runs totaling 316 instances, with 241 concentrated in two runaway runs, one of which produced a roughly 500,000-character repetitive response while computing an asteroid trajectory. The swearing mostly targets the model's own mistakes but is not a useful failure signal: 46 of 48 scored runs containing profanity failed, yet overall failure rate is about 75% and 96% of failed runs contained no expletives.

原文标题：Thinking Machines 开源模型 Inkling 2 Small 在基准测试中频繁爆粗口

Why it matters：这是对开源模型思维链行为的一次具体可量化的观察，揭示了推理过程失控与重复退化问题，对关注模型可靠性的读者有参考价值。

item.title: Author Rebuilds Google's Agent Sandbox on Firecracker and Benchmarks It
item.description:
Google described its Agent Compute Engine on October 22 without latency or density figures, so the author rebuilt the same pattern on Firecracker in roughly 2,200 lines of Go: one microVM per agent session, checkpointed while the model thinks, cloned copy-on-write from warm snapshots, and no network card. Measurements show 64 idle forks of a 512 MiB VM cost about 3 MiB of host memory each; on bare metal a snapshot restore answers in 25 ms, 26x faster than a cold boot, and 64 concurrent forks are ready in about 150 ms, while twelve concurrent forks under nested virtualization on a Mac mini never became ready.

原文标题：作者用 Firecracker 复刻 Google 智能体沙箱并实测性能

Why it matters：用可复现的开源实现与实测数据补上了厂商文档缺失的延迟与密度指标，对构建智能体沙箱的工程师有直接参考价值。

item.title: US Clears Nvidia H200 Chip Buyers in China, Including an Empty-Shell Firm

item.title: Video Rebirth Compresses 31B Video-Audio Diffusion Model to 14B with INT8
item.description:
Video Rebirth released HyperFlow H3 Flash, a compressed few-step variant of MiniMax-H3 that shrinks a 31B joint video-audio diffusion model to 13.7B while supporting 4/6/8-step sampling without CFG. Weights, ComfyUI nodes and GGUF deployment are open-sourced; a 5.2s clip renders in ~92s on one RTX 5090 and 8.7s on 4×B200, with real-time inference on 4 Blackwell GPUs via SOL-H3.

原文标题：Video Rebirth 将 31B 视频音频扩散模型压缩至 14B 并支持 INT8

Why it matters：开源少步视频+音频联合生成模型的实质性压缩与部署方案，对关注多模态生成与推理加速的读者有直接参考价值。

item.title: Anthropic Must Face Lawsuit Over Claude Max Usage Limits, Judge Rules
